mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_memory_state (group_id, project_id, last_message_at, last_processed_sequence, status, attempt_count, updated_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{projectId}, #{at}, 0, 'IDLE', 0, #{at}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_message_at = #{at}, attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = NULL, updated_at = #{at}

INSERT INTO group_memory_state (group_id, project_id, correction, last_message_at, last_processed_sequence, status, attempt_count, updated_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{projectId}, #{correction}, #{at}, 0, 'IDLE', 0, #{at}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE correction = CASE WHEN correction IS NULL OR correction = '' THEN #{correction} ELSE CONCAT(correction, CHAR(10), #{correction}) END, last_message_at = #{at}, attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = NULL, updated_at = #{at}
mapper.update: UPDATE group_memory_state SET updated_at = #{now} WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND claim_token = #{claimToken}

UPDATE group_memory_state SET status = 'IDLE', claim_token = NULL, last_processed_sequence = GREATEST(last_processed_sequence, #{processedThrough}), attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = NULL, last_error = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, discovery_attempt_count = 0, correction = CASE WHEN correction = #{appliedCorrection,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} THEN NULL ELSE correction END WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND claim_token = #{claimToken}
